about: A melee swing's swoosh (MeleeSwingFx, content/weapons melee.swingArt): a white crescent of motion facing right, centred on the hero, tinted with the weapon's colour. Replaces the drawn crescent and flying disc.
name: Swoosh

arc.png.prompt: Paint a single bright white motion swoosh of a fast swing: a thick crescent arc of white light curving around the right half of a circle centered in the picture, its outer edge touching the right edge of the picture, thick in the middle and tapering to thin wisps at its top and bottom tips, a few speed streaks and sparks. Pure light on a plain flat pure black background (#000000), nothing else. Video game effect art.
